title: DFR entry
description: One published entry of a Data Fidelity Register (ledger.json). The seal is SHA-256 over the canonical preimage of exactly six fields: context, label, source_url, time_period, unit, value (see the specification, Deterministic derivation). Other fields are published but not sealed.

label.description: Sealed. What the value is, in the language of the source.

value.description: Sealed. Always a string, as stated by the source.

unit.description: Sealed. Literal null when absent; the string "null" is invalid.

time_period.description: Sealed. The period the fact is about, where the source states one; literal null otherwise.

context.description: Sealed. The passage of the source the entry rests on.

source_url.description: Sealed. The document the entry is faithful to.

source_name.description: Not sealed. Display name of the source document.

seal.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical six-field preimage.

type.description: Not sealed. Publisher's classification of the entry. Optional, non-normative in v0.2 (v0.3 candidate); retired entries are never served.

subject.description: Not sealed. Whom the fact is about, as a relation to the publisher. Optional, non-normative in v0.2 (v0.3 candidate).

subject_name.description: Not sealed. Display name of the subject when it is not the publisher. Optional, non-normative in v0.2 (v0.3 candidate).

url.description: Not sealed. Where this entry is presented on the register. Optional, non-normative in v0.2 (v0.3 candidate).
